zh-CN.title: 广场，换个方式逛
items: 个性化中可切换广场瀑布流，手机双列、桌面三到四列
纯文字发言自动排成文字封面，点击可阅读全文
适配多图首图、视频、音频、音乐专辑和 StillFolio 照片集封面

en.title: A new way to browse Square
items: Choose a masonry Square feed in Personalization: two columns on phones, three or four on desktop
Text-only posts get typographic covers; open a post to read the full text
Covers support photo galleries, video, audio, music albums and StillFolio collections
